extracted.name: Frozen Yogurt Recipe
extracted.description: This homemade Frozen Yogurt recipe can easily be made at home with only 4 ingredients and no special equipment. Customize it by using any frozen fruit combination.
ingredient_lines: 16 ounce bags frozen fruit ((about 4 cups), berries, peaches, pineapple, bananas, etc)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a high-powered blender (ideally with a tamper) or a food processor and blend until smooth. Add an extra spoonful or two of Greek yogurt, if needed, to help it mix.
Freeze for at least 2-3 hours before scooping and serving.
categories: Frozen yogurt recipe without ice cream maker
How to make frozen yogurt without machine
